dashboard.name: Arizona Election Explorer - Production Health
dashboard.description: API performance, error spikes and refresh health. Filtered local logs are capped; APM metrics drive volume alerts.

rawConfiguration.text:
## Arizona Election Explorer — API performance
Normal API requests exclude Docker health checks and the long-lived SSE update stream. Throughput/error volume use APM metrics; latency percentiles and endpoint breakdowns use transaction events (which can be sampled). Process memory covers the Python backend, not the Windows host. No browser page-load or infrastructure agent is installed. Alert issues stay in New Relic; no email/SMS workflow.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(count(apm.service.transaction.duration),1 minute) AS 'API RPM' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND transactionName NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago

FROM Transaction SELECT percentile(duration*1000,95) AS 'p95 ms' WHERE appName = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND name NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago

FROM Metric SELECT 100 * count(apm.service.transaction.error.count) / count(apm.service.transaction.duration) AS 'Error %' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND transactionName NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago

FROM Transaction SELECT percentile(duration*1000,50,95,99) WHERE appName = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND name NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Metric SELECT rate(count(apm.service.transaction.duration),1 minute) AS 'API RPM' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND transactionName NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago TIMESERIES 1 minute

widgets.title: Web errors / minute — includes health and SSE failures

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(count(apm.service.error.count),1 minute) AS 'Errors/min' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' SINCE 60 minutes ago TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Metric SELECT 100 * count(apm.service.transaction.error.count) / count(apm.service.transaction.duration) AS 'Error %' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND transactionName NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago TIMESERIES 1 minute

widgets.title: Endpoints — p95 latency, volume and 5xx (sampled events)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Transaction SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', percentile(duration*1000,95) AS 'p95 ms', filter(count(*),WHERE http.statusCode >= 500) AS '5xx' WHERE appName = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND name NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago FACET name LIMIT 15

FROM Transaction SELECT average(databaseDuration)*1000 AS 'Mean DB ms' WHERE appName = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND name NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT average(apm.service.memory.physical) AS 'Memory MB' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' SINCE 60 minutes ago TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Metric SELECT rate(count(apm.service.transaction.duration),1 minute) AS 'All web RPM' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' SINCE 60 minutes ago TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Metric SELECT rate(count(apm.service.transaction.duration),1 minute) AS 'Health RPM' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND transactionName = 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health' SINCE 60 minutes ago TIMESERIES 1 minute

rawConfiguration.text:
## Errors and refresh operations
Forwarded logs are rate-capped and deduplicated: use APM metric panels for error volume, logs for diagnosis. An empty errors table is normal when no errors were recorded. Refresh runs every six hours in Asia/Kolkata. A missed-refresh alert arms after it sees a successful live completion; it cannot infer a heartbeat from quiet logs. Telemetry loss is a reporting-silence check, not an external public HTTPS availability test.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT count(apm.service.error.count) AS 'Errors' WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' SINCE 5 minutes ago
FROM Log SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL') AS 'Critical' WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' SINCE 60 minutes ago
FROM Log SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE event = 'refresh_completed' AND outcome = 'success') AS 'Successful refreshes' WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' SINCE 24 hours ago
FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'Errors' WHERE appName = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' SINCE 60 minutes ago FACET error.class LIMIT 15

FROM Transaction SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' WHERE appName = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND name NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates') SINCE 60 minutes ago FACET http.statusCode TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS 'Forwarded events' WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND severity IN ('WARNING','ERROR','CRITICAL') SINCE 60 minutes ago FACET service TIMESERIES 5 minutes
FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS 'Forwarded events' WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND severity IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL') SINCE 60 minutes ago FACET service,event LIMIT 15

FROM Log SELECT timestamp,severity,service,event,exception.type,route,correlation_id WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND severity IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL') SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 30

widgets.title: Latest refresh completions — outcome and job ID

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT timestamp,outcome,duration_ms,exit_code,correlation_id WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND event = 'refresh_completed' SINCE 2 days ago LIMIT 20
FROM Log SELECT latest(duration_ms) AS 'Refresh duration ms' WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND event = 'refresh_completed' SINCE 2 days ago TIMESERIES 1 hour
FROM Log SELECT timestamp,service,event,feed,correlation_id WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND severity = 'WARNING' SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 15

conditions.name: Web error burst - 5 minute count
conditions.description: Warning: at least one web error in a five-minute bucket. Critical: at least five. Includes health/SSE errors. APM metrics, not capped logs.

nrql.query: FROM Metric SELECT count(apm.service.error.count) WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web'

conditions.name: API error rate - sustained
conditions.description: API error rate above 2% warning or 5% critical for five minutes. Health/SSE excluded. Quiet windows are not fabricated as zero.

nrql.query: FROM Metric SELECT 100 * count(apm.service.transaction.error.count) / count(apm.service.transaction.duration) WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND transactionName NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates')

conditions.name: API p95 latency - sustained
conditions.description: p95 above 500 ms warning or 1000 ms critical for five minutes. Initial conservative limits; excludes health checks and long-lived SSE.

nrql.query: FROM Transaction SELECT percentile(duration*1000,95) WHERE appName = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND name NOT IN ('WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:health', 'WebTransaction/Function/backend.app.main:early_voting_updates')

conditions.name: APM reporting silent for 5 minutes
conditions.description: Loss-of-signal critical after five minutes without web metrics. Existing health checks normally maintain this signal. Not an external HTTPS probe.

nrql.query: FROM Metric SELECT count(apm.service.transaction.duration) WHERE entity.guid = 'ODY3NTQ4MHxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTEzNDY5NDIwOA' AND transactionType = 'Web'

conditions.name: Refresh job failed
conditions.description: Critical when a forwarded refresh failure is observed. Best effort because forwarding is capped; missed-success alert adds separate coverage.

nrql.query: FROM Log SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE (event = 'refresh_completed' AND outcome = 'failed') OR event = 'refresh_runtime_failed') WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)'

conditions.name: Successful refresh missing for 7 hours
conditions.description: Loss-of-signal after seven hours without a successful six-hour refresh. Arms only after the alert engine sees a matching live success. No artificial gap fill.

nrql.query: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)' AND event = 'refresh_completed' AND outcome = 'success'

conditions.name: Critical service event observed
conditions.description: Critical for a forwarded CRITICAL event from any app service. Local logs retain full critical events; forwarding caps can drop events.

nrql.query: FROM Log SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL') WHERE application = 'Arizona Election Explorer (Production)'
